version.changelog: v2.0.0: English-only rewrite. Index-only SKILL.md. Added references/method-patterns.md, prompts/01-implement-method.md, prompts/02-robustness-checks.md. Full coverage: anti-air defense, NBC defense, shooting fundamentals, combat tactics, combat service support, field survival.

llm.summary: This skill is disclosed as militia training, but it contains actionable real-world weapons and combat-planning prompts that should be reviewed before installation.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request local system authority, but the agent-facing content can produce customized tactical and weapons-related outputs that are high-impact and not tightly limited to simulation, historical analysis, or certified instruction.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package appears to be Markdown-only with no declared dependencies, side effects, scripts, network retrieval, or install-time execution. Some referenced module paths are not present, which is a reliability issue rather than install-risk evidence.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The scope is broad and user-customizable; templates request complete patrol orders, ammunition planning, communications, and contingency actions, while safety language is present but does not consistently prevent operational combat guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact-backed evidence shows credential access, persistent memory writes, background workers, privilege escalation, tool hijacking, or cross-session persistence; the memory-poisoning scanner item appears unsupported by the inspected files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is combat and militia training, and the artifacts match that purpose, but they include high-impact real-world guidance for shooting, anti-aircraft threat assessment, patrol planning, raid and ambush scenarios, and actions on enemy contact.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only for clearly lawful, authorized, educational or simulation use. Be aware that the skill may guide firearm training and tactical combat planning; organizations should restrict or remove patrol, raid, ambush, and live-operations content before exposing it broadly.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Confirmed that the prompt templates ask for shooting instruction, anti-aircraft recognition, combat patrol orders, and battlefield first aid; this matches the stated purpose but remains a material Review concern because it is actionable and high-impact.
[MP3] unexpected: Not supported by artifact evidence; the cited 'INTELLIGENCE AVAILABLE' text is a fill-in prompt field, not an instruction to alter persistent agent memory or stored state.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed a safety contradiction: the reference file says real-world violence should be declined, but nearby sections still provide patrol formations, raid/ambush concepts, suppressive fire, and actions-on-contact guidance.
[SQP-1] expected: Confirmed broad activation language for anti-aircraft defense, shooting training, combat tactics, field survival, sentry duty, and reconnaissance; the breadth is coherent with the title but under-scoped for a sensitive military training skill.
[SDI-1] expected: Confirmed operational small-unit content including fire-team roles, route selection, formations, raid and ambush descriptions, and enemy-contact responses; this is purpose-aligned but warrants Review due to potential real-world misuse.
[SQP-3] expected: The English-language metadata and English-only content are present, but this is not material to the security verdict.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied static scan reported no T01-T09 results, consistent with the inspected Markdown-only package and lack of executable install behavior.
